INPUT 1 current in-game red and silver Furyship export is the strict aircraft identity reference, not a generic jet; INPUT 2 current accepted Yuri full body is the strict character reference. INPUT 3 approved sunset runway/HQ is only the camera and lighting reference, never scenery in the sprites.
FRAME FORMAT: 32 frames total, exact 8 columns x 4 rows, equal 256x256 cells, total 2048x1024 intended. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no labels, no grid lines, no scenery, no text. Crisp detailed HD Neo Geo pixel art, warm sunset rim light, solid correct black costume outlines. One common scale and fixed physical pivot per animation, no movement across cells, no changing body size.
TOP TWO ROWS (16 frames, row-major 0-15): SAME red and silver current Furyship, 3/4 REAR view facing away toward Fury HQ. The fuselage is LEVEL AND HORIZONTAL with the pavement, low and shallow rear perspective, like a real aircraft on its landing wheels. Do NOT stand it upright on its tail. Nose points away and slightly right into screen, engine exhaust faces camera, landing gear bears its weight. Preserve current silhouette, pointed nose, four forward pods, twin rear engines, wing and cockpit layout. Keep the engine mounts fixed at cell(128,154), craft drawn about 180px wide, hull and wing outline same size every frame. Frame0 starts level airborne with landing gear retracted and short cyan exhaust. Frames1-5 the gear unfolds with mechanical articulation and hovering exhaust flickers. Frames6-10 gear fully extended, landing struts compress through smooth touchdown and short downwash; nose and wings remain level. Frames11-13 exhaust powers down, wheels settled, full craft looks FLAT on the ground. Frames14-15 canopy opens slightly and a narrow disembark ladder deploys on the craft's RIGHT side; ship remains stationary and grounded. No pilot aboard visible, no aircraft shadow; shadow is a separate layer. Never twist or change the aircraft. This is a landing and engine shutoff, not a flight turn or tumbling.
THIRD ROW (8 frames,16-23): ONLY Yuri, the exact male pilot with brown/red tall mohawk, shaved sides, dark beard, red flight jacket over white shirt, black scarf, black trousers, red/black armored boots and gloves, male pilot with brown/red tall mohawk, shaved sides, dark beard, red flight jacket over white shirt, black scarf, black trousers, red/black armored boots and gloves, harness, gloves and boots from body reference. Full intact person, two arms, two legs. Yuri climbs down a boarding ladder toward the right side, rendered right-facing profile/3-quarter rear. No ladder included (it belongs to craft above). Animate both hands descending rungs, feet stepping down, then straightens and turns away from camera. Bottom-center foot pivot at(128,224), head height about155px, consistent proportions. Keep feet/head centered; game will move him along the ladder trajectory. His final pose looks toward HQ in 3/4 rear view.
BOTTOM ROW (8 frames,24-31): ONLY same Yuri, an actual smooth repeating 8-frame walking cycle AWAY FROM THE CAMERA, slight 3/4 rear toward left, full body. One full alternating gait, heel strike, lift, opposite leg step, relaxed counter-swing arms. Camera sees back of head and male pilot with brown/red tall mohawk, shaved sides, dark beard, red flight jacket over white shirt, black scarf, black trousers, red/black armored boots and gloves, correct harness. Same bottom-center pivot(128,224), same character height155px throughout, no root movement. Frame31 loops seamlessly into frame24. Absolutely no ship in bottom two rows. This is a game-ready sheet, no contact sheet inset, no background, no invented pilot. Separate 16-frame landing +8-frame disembark +8-frame walk with all32 cells.
INPUT ORDER OVERRIDE: image1 is the exact current Yuri Furyship, image2 the exact accepted Yuri full-body character (strict identity: male pilot with brown/red tall mohawk, shaved sides, dark beard, red flight jacket over white shirt, black scarf, black trousers, red/black armored boots and gloves). Image3 is Cole's APPROVED 32-cell animation template: reuse exact perspective, poses, phases, fixed anchors, but replace identity and palette throughout. Body costume follows image2. Do not tint Cole or reuse his face. All32 cells, 16craft +8ladder +8walking away. Keep hull level and pilot intact. No ladders or props in character-only cells.
